title: Blackened Air Fryer Salmon Bites
description: Cubed salmon coated in a smoky, spiced blackening rub and air-fried until crisp at the edges.
steps: Toss the salmon cubes with the spices, garlic and oil.
Air fry at 200C for 6-8 minutes, shaking halfway.
Serve immediately while the edges are crisp.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste blackened air fryer salmon bites

notes: A 10-minute dinner with almost no cleanup — great over a quick salad or rice.
